title: Posters sold so far
observableEvidence: Converts a percent to a decimal and uses a known part and percent to find the whole.
prompt: A school store has sold 28 posters so far. That is 40% of all the posters it had at the start. Write 40% as a decimal, then find how many posters the store had at the start.
solutionRepresentation: 40% = 0.40 = 0.4. If 0.4 of the whole is 28, the whole is 28 ÷ 0.4 = 70 posters. Check: 10% of 70 is 7, so 40% is 28.
solutionMethod: Convert the percent to a decimal, then divide the known part by that decimal (or find 10% first and scale up to 100%).

deterministicValidator.canonicalAnswer: 40% as a decimal: 0.4; Posters at the start: 70 posters
acceptedAnswers: 40% as a decimal: 0.4; Posters at the start: 70 posters
deterministicValidator.equivalenceNotes: Structured number fields. The decimal accepts decimal form only. Both must be correct; no partial credit.

hintSteps.prompt: 28 posters is a part, and 40% tells what portion of the whole that part is.
hintSteps.question: Is the number you need bigger or smaller than 28?

hintSteps.prompt: 40% is 4 groups of 10%. Find how many posters are in 10% first.
hintSteps.question: If 4 groups of 10% are 28 posters, how many posters are in one group?

hintSteps.prompt: A different example: if 15 tickets are 30% of a roll, then 10% is 5 tickets and 100% is 50 tickets.
hintSteps.question: How many groups of 10% make the whole?
